The '''Aspect of the Void''' is an {{Epic}} [[Swords|Sword]] and an upgrade to the {{Item|Aspect of the End}}. It is unlocked as a recipe at {{Coll|Enderman Slayer LVL 6}}. However, it does not require {{Coll|Enderman Slayer LVL 6}} to use.

The '''Aspect of the Void''' isn't good for melee damage at the stage of the game players will be in when obtaining, but its abilities have great usage throughout the game.

When the ability is used, it arrests its user's momentum and teleports them 8 blocks in the direction they are looking. This teleport cannot pass through walls, including iron bars, but can pass through 1-block holes in iron bar walls. After teleporting, its user gains 50 {{Stat|spd}} for 3s. The potency of this speed boost does not stack with multiple uses, but the duration does. The ability has no cooldown and costs 45 [[Mana]] (50 [[Mana]] for the [[Aspect of the End]]). Like other mobility items, the ability cannot be used in [[The Catacombs - Floor VII]] boss room. The bonuses provided from a full set of {{Item|Strong Dragon Armor}} that affect the Aspect of the End also apply to the Aspect of the Void.

It can be upgraded with [[Transmission Tuner]]s to increase its range by 1 additional block. It can be upgraded up to 4 times for a maximum of 12 total blocks. If an [[Aspect of the End]] has been upgraded with the maximum number of Tuners, the resulting Aspect of the Void cannot receive any more.

Like the Aspect of the End, it can be reforged to Warped with a {{Item|Warped Stone}}, granting it  {{Stat|Damage|+165}} and {{Stat|str|+165}}. With this, it can be stronger than a fully maxed 50m Midas Sword when used outside [[Dungeons]], provided it has the same upgrades. However, since it cannot be dungeonized anymore, it is not the best option for Dungeons.

=== Etherwarp Conduit ===
It can be combined with an [[Etherwarp Conduit]] and an [[Etherwarp Merger]]. This grants it the [[Etherwarp Conduit]]'s long-range teleport ability when right clicking while sneaking.

== Trivia ==
* Unlike the [[Aspect of the End]], when using the ability in 1.8.9, the user does not slow down to sneaking speed due to the blocking animation. It also can be held down to continuously teleport, making it more efficient than an Aspect of the End. However, if a player plays in a version which is later than 1.8.9, the Aspect of the End and Aspect of the Void only had the 5 Mana difference.
*Comparing both the [[Aspect of the End]] and [[Aspect of the Void]] with only the [[Ultimate Wise|Ultimate Wise V]] enchants on each, the [[mana]] cost would change to 25 [[mana]] for the [[Aspect of the End]], and 23 [[mana]] for the [[Aspect of the Void]] (2 [[mana]] cost difference).
* Using the sword's ability just before hitting the ground will cancel any fall damage.
* The item ability will always teleport the player to an integer Y coordinate, and 0.5 + an integer X and Z coordinates, which means that every time you use the ability, you will always end up in the middle of a block.
* The item ability {{AN|Instant Transmission}} is likely a reference to the [[fandom:dragonball:Instant Transmission|technique]] used in [[w:Dragon Ball|Dragon Ball]] with the same name.
* Despite the recipe being locked behind {{Coll|Enderman Slayer LVL 6}}, this item can be used before the player unlocks the recipe, meaning there's no requirements for using this item.
* When reforged to Warped, it and its prior form, the [[Aspect of the End]], were the only non-accessory Dungeon items which could not be upgraded with stars, which was a feature that was later removed. 
** If it was reforged away from Warped, it would retain its status as a Dungeon item.
* When this item first released, it used to be able to teleport in The Catacombs - Floor VII boss room using Ether Transmission when combined with a [[Etherwarp Conduit]].
** This was patched very soon after the bug was found.
* Prior to the 0.19.10 update, it was better to reforge the '''Aspect of the Void''' to {{Reforge|Heroic}} for more {{stat|int}} once the player had a better weapon to use for damage, but now the {{Reforge|Warped}} reforge gives higher {{stat|int}}, as well as {{stat|dmg}} and {{stat|str}}.
